newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two killed, three hurt in Mexico train wreck.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, three hurt in Mexico train wreck.

text.p: Two railroad workers were killed and three injured on Wednesday in an accident just south of Mexico City, officials said.
A maintenance train derailed on a steep hillside about 12 miles (20 km) south of Mexico City as it was on its way to the city of Cuernavaca, the Mexican National Railroad reported.
"The cause of the accident is being investigated," the railroad said in a statement.
Engineer Gonzalo Torres Diego and his assistant, Daniel Monroy Tavares, died in the accident, the railroad said. Three other workers suffered minor injuries.
Red Cross workers at the scene said the train had derailed and flipped over, Red Cross radio operator Carlos Alquicira told Reuters.
A separate Red Cross operator earlier reported that 14 had died, but the Red Cross quickly corrected that information, confirming the version told by the national railroad company.
